# Data Engineer

**Kornmod Foods A/S** · Aarhus (remote within Denmark, or hybrid from our Aarhus office) · 2 positions

Kornmod bakes bread and crispbread for supermarkets in six countries. Our data platform
feeds production planning, sales and finance, and we are hiring two data engineers to
build it out.

## What you will do

- Build and own data models in dbt on Snowflake.
- Bring data in from our production lines, ERP and customers' sales data.
- Make data reliable, documented and tested.

## What we are looking for

- At least 3 years as a data engineer, analytics engineer or similar.
- Strong SQL and data modelling.
- Experience with dbt.
- Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse.
- Python for scripts and pipelines.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Airflow or another orchestrator.
- Spark for larger jobs.

We offer a permanent position, fresh bread every day and a yearly trip to the bakery.
